gitCommit.subject: fix(photos): sort photos no longer stick on the letter after one failed load (#381)
gitCommit.body:
fix(photos): sort photos no longer stick on the letter after one failed load (#381)

* fix(photos): a load failure belongs to its photo, and retries once (purses-d87z)

During a sort the same CardImage slot is reused for every piece (compare keys a/b, one ItemCard in feelings). CardImage stored a failure without its src, so one dropped request on a phone blanked that slot to the letter for the rest of the sort. The failure is now keyed to its src (a new photo starts clean) and a first failure retries with a fresh request before the fallback.
